page.layout: One page: a full-page engraved plate occupies the upper and middle area with no running text. Below the plate, at the right, a catchword. At the lower left, a footnote in small type.

main_text.p: * De vita Conft. 1. c. xxxiii. & alibi.

page.notes: The page is largely an engraving (plate) with faint, illegible inscribed lettering in the lower centre of the image, which is not transcribed. No page number or running head is printed. The catchword "fortun-" is read at the right below the plate rule. The footnote marker is an asterisk. "Conft." is read as printed, and the roman numeral is doubtful in its case.
